overview: The Rossford Police Department uses Flock Safety technology to capture objective evidence without compromising on individual privacy. RPD utilizes retroactive searches to solve crimes after they've occurred. Additionally, RPD utilizes real time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals. In an effort to ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, we have made the below policies and usage statistics available to the public.
acceptable_use: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by Rossford OH PD and is never sold to 3rd parties.
prohibited_uses: Harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), non-law enforcement use, personal use.
access_policy: All system access requires a case number, CAD number, or description of investigation. This information is stored indefinitely.
hotlist_policy:
Hotlist hits are required to be human verified prior to action.
Myth vs. Fact
Myth

more_info.Success Stories:
12/2023 A Flock ALPR alerted to a stolen vehicle on Buck Road in Rossford. The vehicle was located at Buck and Glenwood Roads and a felony stop was conducted. The driver of the vehicle was in possession of two loaded firearms, one of which was reported stolen out of Detroit. The vehicle and one of the firearms were also involved in a shooting in Detroit. The driver was arrested and charged with receiving stolen property.

1/2024 Officers responded to a residence in Rossford on a report of a home invasion during which the victim was allegedly tied up and multiple firearms were stolen from his residence. Through the use of Flock, several vehicles were identified that were involved in the offense, which led to arrests being made.

11/2025 Detectives investigated a theft of $14,763.00 worth of merchandise from a business in Rossford. Flock was used to identify the suspect vehicle and they were also notified through Flock that the vehicle was involved in a missing juvenile investigation being conducted by the Toledo Police Department.  As a result, the missing juvenile was located and the stolen property was recovered. Two suspects were charged with Felony Theft and also have pending charges related to the missing juvenile out of Toledo.

2/2026 Flock was used to identify the vehicle driven by a suspect in a Felonious Assault investigation which occurred at a business in Rossford. The victim of the assault required reconstructive surgeries to his face. Once the driver of the vehicle was identified, three other suspects were also identified which resulted in their arrests for Felonious Assault, a second degree felony offense.
